subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for booking your upcoming flight with us. We are pleased to confirm your reservation for Flight ABC123 from City A to City B on [Date] at [Time]. Please find attached your e-ticket for reference. Should you require any assistance or have any special requests, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
